I never expected you to appear so suddenly back there, Sarasvati.
The situation was urgent. I had no choice.
strings.묻고 싶은 게 있어요. 사라스바티는 베르겔미르를 알고 있었던 거죠?: There's something I want to ask. You already knew about Bergelmir, didn't you?
You said weapons like Bergelmir destroyed worlds.
strings.(사라스바티의 앞에 있던 홀로그램 키보드가 사라지고 새로운 홀로그램 스크: (The holographic keyboard in front of Sarasvati vanishes, replaced by a new holographic screen.)
strings.오래전의 이야기입니다. 모험가님께서도 어느 정도 알고 있는 이곳이 아닌: This happened long ago. It is the history of a place beyond the Great Wall, rather than here. You already know something of it, Adventurer...
strings.인류는 언제나 자신들의 이권을 위해 싸웠습니다. 약한 자들은 사라졌고,: Humanity has always fought for its own interests. The weak disappeared, and the strong survived to become history.
strings.그 역사엔 언제나 전쟁이 있었고, 전쟁엔 적으로 규정한 이들을 쓰러뜨리기: War was a constant in that history. And war always involved power used to defeat those designated as enemies.
strings.네, 무기는 점차 정교해져 상대를 쓰러뜨리는 수준에서 별 하나를 파괴할: Yes. Weapons became ever more sophisticated, progressing from the ability to defeat an opponent to the power to destroy an entire planet.
Yes. Bergelmir is a weapon made by the ancestors of this world's inhabitants...
strings.병기를 만든 이들이 이해관계가 맞지 않는 대상의 거주지를 '악'으로 규정: Its creators branded the homes of anyone whose interests opposed theirs as "evil" and ordered their complete destruction.
strings.어떤 별은 흔적도 없이 사라졌지요. 베르겔미르가 온 건 결코 우연이 아닙: Some planets disappeared without a trace. Bergelmir's arrival here was no coincidence.
strings.그런데 베르겔미르는 이 별이 자신이 파괴해야 할 별이 아니란 사실을 깨닫: But Bergelmir realized this was not a planet it should destroy, and chose to remain.
strings.그가 왜 그랬는지 분석하고 있지만, 답을 알 수는 없었습니다. 다만 확실: I have been analyzing why, but I have yet to find an answer. One thing is certain: the machine developed a soul...
strings.모험가님께서 이미 비슷한 형태로 마도골렘, 그러니까 MG라 불리는 것의: You have seen something similar in the form of magic golems, also known as MGs.
strings.이 별에는 간혹 신비한 것들이 많다고 들었지요. 혹시 영혼이 깃든 골렘에: I understand this planet contains many mysterious things. Do you know anyone knowledgeable about golems with souls?
strings.(영혼이 깃든 골렘…. 주로 골렘은 사용자의 의지로 만들어진 것이 많으니: (Golems with souls... Most golems are shaped by the will of their users...)
Please leave out what happened in Oneiro Forest when you ask.
All right. I'll look into it.
strings.(일단 생각나는 사람이 없네…. 아틀란티스에 있는 마리에게 물어볼까? 이: (No one comes to mind... Maybe I should ask Mari in Atlantis? She had an Eraser...)
strings.안녕하세요, %s 님. 아틀란티스에는 오랜만이네요?: Hello, %s. It's been a while since you visited Atlantis!
strings.절 찾아오신 걸 보니 무슨 일이 있는 건가요?: Did you need something? You came looking for me, after all.
strings.(마리에게 영혼을 가진 마도 골렘에 대해 묻는다.): (You ask Mari about magic golems with souls.)
MGs with souls? Artificial intelligence, maybe...
strings.사람하고 대화할 수 있는 정도의 인공지능이 있긴 하지만, 완벽하게 자기: There's AI advanced enough to talk to people, but nothing with a fully independent will.
strings.마법적인 건가? 프레이오스 대륙 사람들이 더 잘 알까요?: Is it something magical? Maybe someone from Freios would know more.
strings.드워프 종족이 엄청난 기술을 가지고 있다고 들었어요. 한 번 그들에게 물: I've heard the dwarves have incredible technology. Why not ask them?
strings.(그럼 아키시티에 있는 도룬에게 물어볼까…?): (Should I ask Dorun in Archi City, then...?)
strings.오오, 용자님! 도룬을 찾아오시다니 영광입니다!: Oh, brave hero! What an honor for you to visit me, Dorun!
strings.저 도룬! 용자님에게 도움이 될테니 말씀만 하십쇼!: I, Dorun, will be of service! You need only ask, brave hero!
All right. The reason I've come is...
strings.(도룬에게 영혼을 가진 마도 골렘에 대해 묻는다.): (You ask Dorun about magic golems with souls.)
strings.저 도룬! 용자님에게 도움이 될 테니 마도 골렘에 관한 것만 빼고 말씀만: I, Dorun, will be of service! Ask me anything except questions about magic golems!
strings.아! 길드 연합 도시에 아주 훌륭한 마도 골렘 전문가가 있다고 들었습니다: Ah! I've heard there's an outstanding expert on magic golems in the Guild Alliance city!
A young girl with animal ears...
Oh, that girl I passed when I went to see Dayna...
strings.도룬, 고마워요! 그럼 가볼게요!: Thank you, Dorun! I'll be going!
strings.용자님! 다시 또 찾아주십시오! 저 도룬, 용자님에게 도움이 될 테니!: Please visit again, brave hero! I, Dorun, will be of service!
strings.안녕…하세요. 얼마 전에 이 안으로 들어오신 분이시죠? %s 님이시라고…: Hello... You came in here a little while ago, didn't you? You're %s...
strings.네, 맞아요. 이름이… 나르샤였죠? 전에 암브로시아와 아니스에게서 들은: Yes, that's right. Your name is... Narsha, isn't it? Ambrosia and Anise mentioned you before.
Really? What work are those two trying to make me do now...?
Oh, nothing like that. I came because I wanted to ask you something.
strings.혹시 마도골렘의 영혼이라고 알아요?: Have you heard of magic golems having souls?
Do you know about the souls? It sounds like you already know something...
strings.무슨 말인지 잘 모르겠어요. 사실 제가 나르샤에게 마도 골렘에 대해 묻는: I'm not sure what you mean. The reason I'm asking about magic golems is...
strings.(나르샤에게 오네이로 숲에서 거대한 골렘 같은 걸 만나 싸웠다고 간단하게: (You briefly explain that you encountered and fought something like a giant golem in Oneiro Forest.)
You've done a lot since arriving. I knew you were busy, but...
strings.유명하신 분이니 모를 리가 없죠. 세계를 몇 번씩이나 구하셨다고 데이나: Of course. You're famous. President Dayna told me you've saved the world several times.
strings.마도골렘 중에는 가끔 동력 없이 움직일 수도 있는 것들이 있어요. 마치: Some magic golems can occasionally move without a power source. Almost as if they have minds of their own...
strings.고대 시절에는 이런 마도골렘들이 마을을 부수는 일들이 많았대요. 그래서: I've heard that golems like that often destroyed villages in ancient times. They needed a way to control them.
strings.프레이오스는 다른 대륙에 비해 마법이 활성화된 곳이라 마도 골렘을 제어할: Magic is more widespread in Freios than on other continents, so some people here have the power to control magic golems. Myself included...
That's how professions using magic golems developed, along with research into them.
strings.주로 실바리아 제국 마법청에서 연구를 많이 해요. 그래서 그곳에서 용어도: The Silvaria Empire's Magic Bureau conducts much of that research and defines the terminology. They call the seemingly conscious mind of a golem that requires control a "magic soul."
strings.인간과 동물과 같은 일반 생명의 것과 다르지만요. 아직도 정확하진 않지만: It's different from the soul of an ordinary living thing, like a human or an animal. We don't fully understand it yet... But magic souls can be transferred...
They're definitely different from artificial intelligence.
strings.이걸로 답이 됐나요, 모험가님?: Does that answer your question, Adventurer?
Yes, to some extent. I'll be going, then...
Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.
strings.제가 좀 더 알아보고 싶은 게 있는데, 실례가 안 된다면 돌아가시는 걸: There's something I'd like to investigate further. If you don't mind, could you put off leaving for a little while?
strings.아직도 그게 남아있을지 모르겠지만, 어쩌면 모험가님이라면 다시 발견할 수: I don't know if anything remains, but you might be able to find it again.
strings.그 골렘, 골렘의 부품을 찾아서 저에게 가져다주시겠어요? 아니면 비슷한: Could you find a part from that golem and bring it to me? Or anything similar... Then I can investigate more closely!
strings.(어, 엄청나게 눈동자가 반짝거리네…. 친구 아니랄까 봐 암브로시아와 아: (Wow, her eyes are practically sparkling... She's just like Ambrosia and Anise. No wonder they're friends.)
There are things I want to know too, so I'll go. Wait for me.
I'll have to return to Oneiro. I wonder if any trace of Bergelmir remains...
strings.(나르샤의 시선이 %s의 손에 있는 물건에 꽂혀 있다.): (Narsha's eyes are fixed on the object in %s's hand.)
Here you go, Narsha. It wasn't easy to find.
Thank you, Adventurer. So this is a part from that golem.
strings.(나르샤가 창고로 보이는 곳에 들어갔다가 뭔가 들고 나온다.): (Narsha goes into what appears to be a storage room and returns carrying something.)
strings.가져오신 골렘의 부품은 확실히 제가 지금까지 봤던 마도골렘의 것과 달라요: The part you brought is definitely different from any magic golem component I've seen. Its technology seems far more advanced than anything in this world today.
strings.오래된 것 같은 부품이네요?: That looks like an old part.
strings.네, 맞아요. 오래된 부품…. 유물 같은 거예요. 엘 아노르 산악지대에서: Yes, it is. An old component... A relic, really. It was discovered in the El Anoir Mountains. It dates back to the Twilight, when the gods fought.
strings.그 당시 어떤 위대한 존재가 골렘을 만들어 움직이게 했는데, 거기서 떨어: A great being made and animated a golem back then. This piece fell off it.
See the markings engraved on this relic and the part you brought...?
They're the same. Wait, that doesn't make sense...
strings.어째서 그 골렘이 이스트랜드의 모로스에서 있었던 건지는 모르겠지만…. 확: I don't know why that golem was in Moros, in Eastland... But one thing is certain...
The golem the gods used and the one you saw in Oneiro Forest appear to be the same kind.
strings.그리고 전이된 흔적이 있네요?: And there are signs of a transfer.
strings.제 마도리를 보시겠어요?: Would you take a look at Madori?
strings.마도리는 제 어깨 위에 있는 마도 골렘이에요. 거대한 바디에서 '마도영혼: Madori is the magic golem on my shoulder. I transferred its magic soul from a giant body into a small one.
There's a way to shrink a large magic golem? I've never heard of that...
strings.마법청의 도움이 있었어요. 현재 진행형이긴 하지만, 마도골렘에 깃든 자아: The Magic Bureau helped. It's still a work in progress, but think of it as moving the golem's consciousness, its magic soul, into a different vessel.
strings.그건 현재의 기술이고, 아직 연구 중이지만…. 이미 이 골렘은 그 과정을: That's the current technology, and it's still being researched... But this golem seems to have undergone that process already.
I'm sorry I can't give you a more definite answer.
strings.아, 마법학교 제레니스의 교장 선생님께서 쓰신 책을 제가 본 적이 있는데: Oh! I read a book written by the headmaster of Xerenis Magic Academy. It discussed space-time using a magic golem part as an example!
strings.그 책이 꽤 많이 있는 거로 알고 있는데, 그 책을 잘 이야기하면 한 권: I believe there are quite a few copies around. If you explain what you need, you might be able to get one.
It might help whoever sent you here, too.
Thank you. I'll find that book.
Please come back sometime. There's something else I'd like to tell you.
Sometime? All right. I'll head to Xerenis Hill, then...
strings.뭔가 이상한 일이 벌어지는 기분이네…. 대체 뭐지…? 나중에 총장님에게: It feels like something strange is happening... What could it be...? I'll ask the president later.
strings.모험가님이시군요. 잠깐 다른 생각을 하느라 오신지 몰랐네요. 손에 들고: Adventurer. I was lost in thought and didn't notice your arrival. What are you holding...?
I went to see someone knowledgeable about golems, as you asked.
strings.그 사람이 이 책을 사라스바티에게 가져다주면 좀 더 도움이 될 거라 해서: She said bringing you this book might be more helpful.
strings.감사합니다. 저는 이곳에 얽매인 몸…. 부디 나중에 기회가 된다면 그분: Thank you. I am confined to this place... If you have the opportunity, please thank her on my behalf.
strings.그럼 듣고 오신 걸 이야기해주시겠어요?: Would you tell me what you learned?
strings.(사라스바티에게 나르샤와 나눴던 이야기를 전달한다. 시공간에 대한 의문과: (You recount your conversation with Narsha, including the questions about space-time and magic souls...)
strings.(사라스바티에게 전한 책이 거대한 스크린 위로 떠오른다. 그리고 그 속으: (The book you gave Sarasvati rises toward the enormous screen, then melts into it like snow.)
Technology used in weapons thousands of years ago, yet only now beginning to develop...
And an organization within a nation carrying out that development...
strings.위대한 벽의 균열이 정말 많은 오류를 일으켰습니다. 제가 그때 오네이로: The cracks in the Great Wall have caused so many errors. It was fortunate I could stop space-time in Oneiro Forest and enter it that day...
strings.의심스러운 부분이 많지만, 지금은 여기까지 하겠습니다. 나머지는 제가 천: There are many suspicious details, but let us stop here for now. I will investigate the rest at my own pace and let you know.
Some of my questions have been answered too.
I suspect you will have much more to do in the future, Adventurer.
strings.아, 나중에 기회가 된다면 민폐 언니한테 한 번 가주셨으면 합니다. 이건: Ah, if you have a chance, please visit my troublesome older sister. I really am sorry to ask this...
It's all right. There's always going to be plenty for me to do.
I'll be going, Sarasvati. I still have things to take care of...
strings.(사라스바티가 %s의 흔적이 디-라보에서 사라지는 걸 확인한 후, 새로운: (After confirming that %s has left D-Lab, Sarasvati calls up a new screen.)
It seems the time has come to prepare a few protocols I have never used...
